sum: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses in technology, healthcare, and logistics industries. The company was formerly known as D. Boral ARC Acquisition II Corp. and changed its name to ARC Group Acquisition I Corp in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Tempe, Arizona.
ceo: Dr. Sing Ee Wong (CEO & Executive Director)
